findings.entity: Fruit in the blue tray at the left market stall
findings.description: As the foreground blue tray enters view, its apple-shaped fruit has uniformly saturated turquoise skin. This is especially clear around 00:04–00:06, beside normally colored orange, yellow, and green produce under the same lighting. The unnatural coloration makes this portion of the otherwise realistic fruit display look artificially recolored.
